title: Agree a measurement and attribution contract
evidence: Public reporting and revenue positioning exist; no account metric definitions or reconciliation were accessed.
metric: Approved channel, net-sales, attribution and cohort definitions
notes: Requires Internal Access: GA4, Shopify and client finance. P0 is a prerequisite, not a claim of a current tracking defect.

title: Validate indexation and query baseline
evidence: 20/20 sampled pages respond at 200 with index, follow; actual Google indexing and selected canonicals remain unknown.
metric: GSC index exceptions and query/page baseline by cohort
notes: Requires Internal Access: GSC. Compare sitemap, Page indexing and sampled URL Inspection; preserve public controls.

title: Confirm assortment, stock and margin before collection selection
evidence: Transactional collection buildout is public methodology; no client inventory or economics were inspected.
metric: Approved viable collection cohort and commercial constraints
notes: Requires Internal Access: Shopify, merchandising, finance and GSC. No invented product counts, revenue forecast or minimum assortment threshold.

title: Set one account board and definition of done
evidence: The role names Asana, ownership and QA; public cadence includes Friday reporting and quarterly review.
metric: Every accepted task has owner, due window, dependency and QA evidence
notes: Requires Internal Access: Asana/account scope. Agree account capacity and client approvals before promising throughput.

title: Remove repeated brand wording in title templates
evidence: 7/20 sampled titles end in the exact duplicated suffix | SEOasis | SEOasis. Natural brand wording in a case-study subject is not counted as an issue.
metric: Sampled title-template acceptance pass; query-adjusted CTR after baseline
notes: Low-severity clarity improvement. Verify title source and rendered head; no ranking or CTR uplift forecast.

title: Complete one source meta description
evidence: Source description ends with tracks real results. Not vanity me.
metric: Published description is complete and accurately matches the guide
notes: The incomplete ending is in HTML, not an observed Google snippet. Google can choose different snippet text.

title: Refresh two dated implementation references
evidence: A guide lists FID and the audit guide suggests Search Console parameter settings; Google replaced FID with INP and retired that tool.
metric: Primary-source freshness check passes on both instructions
notes: Edit the specific instructions, verify in context and record reviewer/date. Do not use character/word thresholds as ranking rules.

title: Check case-study canonical consistency
evidence: No source canonical appears on the case hub and three sampled case pages; 16 other sampled pages have one.
metric: Preferred case URLs confirmed and template output verified
notes: Requires Internal Access: GSC selected-canonical checks. Omission is not proof of duplicate indexing; confirm preferred URLs before implementation.

title: Test one selected homepage service-hub path
evidence: Homepage source links expose four page destinations; no sampled direct commercial-service path appears.
metric: Useful discovery path and qualified lead behavior
notes: Validate complete rendered graph and focused-navigation intent first. No sitewide orphan or crawl-depth claim.

title: Connect collection methodology and relevant case proof
evidence: Bronson AI copy names collections and hub-and-spoke work but lacks a direct category-service link in sampled HTML.
metric: Relevant contextual link QA and path to service explanation
notes: Use a natural useful sentence and descriptive anchor. Existing service-to-proof links already exist; no reciprocal quota.

title: Assign a primary intent to close service variants
evidence: Agency/company/consultant/expert URLs coexist; sampled agency and company sections share themes.
metric: Query × URL ownership, qualified leads and page-role decisions
notes: Requires Internal Access: GSC, GA4/CRM. Similar words do not establish cannibalization; retain valuable distinct pages.

title: Review overlap between Shopify optimization guides
evidence: Two reviewed guides cover collections, schema, technical checks, Reddit and AI testing.
metric: Differentiated reader tasks or approved consolidation plan
notes: Requires Internal Access: GSC, GA4 and relevant links. Compare intent and outcomes before any merge; plan redirects and link updates if chosen.

title: Release a commercially gated collection pilot
evidence: SEOasis describes transactional collections with real products; this is a reusable client operating proposal.
metric: Released viable intent cohort; search response and landing-cohort purchases
notes: Requires Internal Access: Shopify, GSC, GA4, finance. Gate distinct intent, assortment, copy, stock and margin; no guaranteed page quota.

title: Document collection facets, pagination and index policy
evidence: Official ecommerce guidance separates persistent category URLs, facets and crawlable pagination.
metric: Approved indexable URL set and reachable products across pagination
notes: Client template QA proposal, not an SEOasis agency-site defect. Review robots/noindex/canonical ordering; avoid blocking signals before Google can read them.

title: Validate schema parity and current eligibility rules
evidence: 19/20 sample pages have parseable JSON-LD; syntax alone does not establish semantic accuracy or Google eligibility.
metric: Representative template validation with visible-content parity
notes: FAQ rich results stopped May 7, 2026. No special AI schema; no collection Product stars or self-serving business review-star promise.

title: Verify entity references and video endpoints
evidence: Homepage sameAs is empty and VideoObject contentUrl ends in .jsonp; actual endpoint contents were not fetched.
metric: Verified official entity references and playable video metadata
notes: Validate endpoint media and owned profiles before editing. Use correct embedUrl where actual video-byte URL is unavailable.

title: Establish a repeated AI query evidence panel
evidence: Public AI monitoring is described; no actual AI outputs were collected for this study.
metric: Saved prompt conditions, answers and exact citations over repeated runs
notes: Requires Internal Access to any existing client log/tool history. Suggested manual prompts are not observed outputs; compare like conditions.

title: Build a community listening map for one client
evidence: SEOasis guide describes relevant communities and helpful participation; client community fit was not verified.
metric: Relevant buyer questions, current rules and approved listen/answer/abstain decisions
notes: Use public listening to inform collection research; validate stock, margin and claims before turning questions into pages.

title: Agree a transparent community response gate
evidence: Reddit rules require authentic participation and prohibit spam/manipulation; service work needs client-specific boundaries.
metric: Approved account, affiliation disclosure, human review and escalation process
notes: Prerequisite before participation. No deceptive engagement, manufactured endorsements, coordinated voting or evasion of removals.

title: Validate Merchant Center eligibility before feed tests
evidence: Feed work is public methodology; no client feed diagnostics or product performance was accessed.
metric: Approved/limited/disapproved items and verified free-listing tracking
notes: Requires Internal Access: Merchant Center, GA4 and Shopify. Reconcile GTIN/MPN where applicable, prices, availability, images and destination facts.

title: Pilot a product-title structure before a separate image test
evidence: Mike describes supplemental feeds and title/image experiments in an attributable vendor-hosted interview.
metric: Comparable-cohort free-listing CTR, qualified purchases and reconciled net sales
notes: Requires Internal Access. Confirm eligibility/stock; avoid changing image and title together; annotate promotions and seasonality; no projected lift.

title: Choose a conversion test after funnel reconciliation
evidence: Public pages provide several next-step and proof formats; no conversion friction or performance effect is measured.
metric: Qualified lead behavior for agency; purchase funnel for merchant client
notes: Requires Internal Access: agency GA4/CRM or client GA4/Shopify. Keep agency lead funnel distinct from merchant purchase funnel.

title: Create an approved proof packet with method notes
evidence: Named public cases provide intervention themes while analytics exports and causal controls remain unavailable.
metric: Approved scope, dates, definitions, caveats and usable client quotes
notes: Requires Internal Access for validation and client approval for reuse. Company-reported attribution does not establish incremental revenue.

title: Confirm blog and link-partner scope before briefing
evidence: Role includes blog and link-building coordination while public service messaging deemphasizes these deliverables.
metric: Documented partner scope, quality criteria, owner and account-specific rationale
notes: Unresolved scope question, not a contradiction to explain away. Do not assume a link quota or broad blog-production commitment.

title: Validate a dedicated Shopping explanation against buyer needs
evidence: Shopping methodology has case/founder coverage; no distinct Shopping service URL was found in the reviewed sitemap.
metric: Qualified sales questions and verified target-market intent
notes: A page is optional after delivery scope and demand validation. Peers also use AI messaging; differentiate with useful method and proof, not an exclusivity claim.

title: Close every quarter with keep/expand/revise/stop decisions
evidence: Quarterly recalibration and end-to-end strategist ownership are explicit public expectations.
metric: Every major hypothesis has evidence, decision, rationale and next owner
notes: Requires Internal Access to account outcomes and constraints. Ninety days is a review cadence, not a guaranteed SEO payback window.

title: Turn one successful handoff into a reusable SOP
evidence: Role values documentation, independent ownership and possible future team leadership.
metric: Peer can execute brief and QA without undocumented dependencies
notes: Requires Internal Access: Asana and fulfillment process. Review cycle time, rework and capacity; preserve merchant-specific exceptions.

title: Collect browser and performance evidence before remediation
evidence: The bounded HTTP audit did not collect field Core Web Vitals, mobile interaction or rendered-browser evidence.
metric: Saved mobile/keyboard/browser checks and PSI/CrUX field evidence where available
notes: Public PSI may be accessible without account access; GSC CWV requires access. Lack of a test is not a detected performance defect.
